target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text:
For now, let's remove the landing-page work from scope. On the creative side, the proposed price is too high, and we also do not supply raw footage or voiceover.

The successful ad I shared was produced by another freelancer for 4800/- per video. He is a subject-matter expert, but he is currently unreachable, which is why I am looking here instead.

Your scope would therefore need to cover everything: footage, voiceover, and script. Our counterproposal is 22k inr for 8 video ads, each 45sec long, delivered as 16 finished files.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: For the initial test, how long would you need to prepare 3 videos in 2 formats? We will test these first, and if the test works, we will order 5 more.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: Please list every agreed detail in the offer, including appropriate cuts and Audio DB 18 applied according to proper standards. You can send the offer to me, and I will accept it.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: The whole concept does not work at all. In particular, the hook is far too indirect to hold a user's attention, and this kind of approach will not work in India. Select the relevant keywords from the reference videos I sent and use them directly in the revision instead.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: Please discard this entire script because the safe, indirect approach will not work. Sending the reference videos served no purpose if the result was going to take this direction. Carefully listen to and understand the 4th video and the last video I sent today, extract their key words, and rebuild the script around those.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text:
Please follow these steps:
1\. Use the script from the last reference I sent as the foundation, since it is a good script.
2\. Identify its keywords and key message; that same message is what we want to communicate.
3\. Determine what the script lacks, remove those weak parts, and replace them with something more powerful. Your task is to improve it without adding anything generic—the wording must be unique while still delivering the same message.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: The keywords energy, confidence, stamina and performance are too generic, and using them will push the cpl too high; I mentioned this last time. Review the transcript of my winning video and the latest reference, then write and send the extracted keywords here. Include terms such as timing and dheelapan. The confidence and stamina wording you proposed does not work, and the complete script must be sent in Hindi only.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: Although confidence and stamina can be included, they cannot be the only terms; other reference-derived keywords must be used as well. Also, please send the entire script in Hindi itself.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: Do not use लिंग; remove that word. The product offers the same benefits as the references.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: Use the last reference I sent as the model, then add relevant benefits from both my winner script and that last reference script to create something similar.

target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text: To be honest, the 22 sec preview does not create a good impression or feel real; it is immediately obvious that it was made with AI.
